policy: Archive only officially confirmed closed dated intakes. Keep recurring programme profiles. Inaccessible sources and unknown or indicative dates do not establish expiry. Snapshots preserve the full pre-refresh record.

rounds.reason: Official timeline confirms Cycle 2 submissions ended on 4 September 2026. Review and award notices continue; the recurring programme is retained.

record.name: Epic MegaGrants
record.eligibility: Creators, developers, students and researchers doing notable work with Unreal Engine, 3D or the metaverse
record.funding_amount: Grants historically from about USD 5k to USD 500k, no cap stated
record.other_benefits: No obligation to use Epic products commercially; you keep everything you build
record.ip_conditions: You keep all your IP; no exclusivity
record.key_documents: Project description, portfolio, budget, how it advances the ecosystem
record.project_match: XR / spatial computing, immersive storytelling, Infinity Engine music-visuals, museums
record.why_relevant: Among the most founder-friendly creative grants: no equity, keep your IP, individuals eligible, up to substantial sums. Ideal for the Infinity Engine and immersive-media work.
record.risks: Should involve Unreal / 3D / real-time tech meaningfully; competitive at the top end
record.verify: Confirm the program is still accepting and current scope

pitch.project: Infinity Engine music-visuals pipeline / immersive storytelling
pitch.framing: A real-time, Unreal-powered pipeline turning music into immersive worlds for a local film community.
pitch.next_step: Package a demo reel and technical description, submit the rolling application.

rounds.reason: Official IRCC page requires a valid 2025 commitment certificate and application by 30 June 2026, and states that other applications are closed. The programme is paused.

record.name: Start-up Visa Program
record.status: Ongoing permanent-residency pathway (subject to annual caps)
record.opens: Rolling, subject to intake caps, verify at source
record.eligibility: Founders with a qualifying business supported by a designated VC, angel group or incubator
record.requires_local: Leads to Canadian permanent residency; requires a designated-organisation commitment
record.funding_amount: No direct government cash; the designated organisation may invest; PR is the core benefit
record.support_type: Residency pathway plus potential private investment
record.equity: Depends on the designated backer (often equity)
record.other_benefits: Permanent residency, strong AI research ecosystem (Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver)
record.ip_conditions: You keep your IP; investor terms vary
record.matching_required: Needs a Letter of Support from a designated organisation
record.key_documents: Letter of Support, business plan, language test, settlement funds
record.why_relevant: A rare startup route straight to permanent residency in a top AI-research country. Best if a long-term North American base appeals.
record.risks: Requires securing a designated backer first; capped intake; genuine relocation
record.verify: Confirm current cap status, designated-organisation list and processing times

pitch.framing: A research-driven AI company that fits Canada's AI-institute ecosystem.
pitch.next_step: Pitch a designated incubator or angel group for a Letter of Support.

rounds.reason: Official call component identifies HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01 as closed with deadline 9 September 2026 at 17:00 CEST.

record.name: Horizon Europe and Marie Sklodowska-Curie Actions
record.status: 2026 Postdoctoral Fellowships page lists an indicative 9 September deadline; definitive portal status could not be read
record.opens: Indicative launch 2026-04-09, marked TBC by the publisher
record.closes: Indicative 2026-09-09, marked TBC; not independently confirmed
record.eligibility: Researchers holding a PhD, applying jointly with an eligible beneficiary; detailed host and mobility conditions must be verified in the definitive call
record.au_eligible: European fellowships accept any nationality; Global fellowships require European nationality or long-term residence. Individual host and mobility eligibility remains unverified
record.requires_local: Requires a European (or associated) host institution; mobility rules apply
record.stage: Research-stage; needs an academic or research host
record.funding_amount: Salary, mobility and research costs (MSCA fellowships are well funded); consortia grants far larger
record.other_benefits: Salaried research placement, European lab access, publications, network
record.ip_conditions: IP terms set with the host; negotiable, generally researcher-respecting
record.matching_required: Typically no cash match for MSCA; host provides environment
record.key_documents: Research proposal, host agreement, CV, ethics
record.project_match: Hyperbaric / measured self-development research, dementia, privacy AI
record.why_relevant: A route to salaried, credible research funding on your health, AI and privacy questions with a European host. Turns a long-horizon idea into fundable science.
record.risks: Needs an academic host and formal proposal; not for a company; success rates are low
record.verify: Confirm current MSCA call, host eligibility and Australia participation route

pitch.project: Digitally measured self-development / hyperbaric research or privacy-AI
pitch.framing: A rigorous research question needing a European host and instrumentation.
pitch.next_step: Find a willing European lab / supervisor, co-write an MSCA Postdoctoral proposal.

verification.notes: Not archived: the source labels its dates TBC and the linked Funding & Tenders page was unavailable. A past indicative date alone is insufficient evidence of closure.

rounds.reason: Official Closed round section gives 22 September 2026 at 15:00 BST, no late applications. Rolling intake from 23 September remains available.

record.name: Wellcome Trust research funding (incl. Mental Health)
record.status: Discovery, mental health, infectious disease, and climate-and-health funding directory available; eligibility and dates vary by scheme
record.eligibility: Researchers, often needing an eligible host organisation; some schemes accept international applicants
record.au_eligible: Not established generally: Australian citizenship, host location and each scheme must be checked separately
record.requires_local: Host organisation usually required; not a company grant
record.other_benefits: Prestige, multi-year support, global health-research network
record.ip_conditions: Open-access and data-sharing expectations; IP terms via host
record.matching_required: Often no cash match; host provides environment
record.key_documents: Research proposal, host support, ethics, team
record.project_match: Dementia support, preventative health, mental health, measured self-development
record.why_relevant: A premier funder for your health, ageing and dementia interests, including digital mental-health tools. Turns a wellbeing idea into serious funded research.
record.risks: Requires an eligible research host and rigorous proposal; open-access expectations; low success rates
record.verify: Confirm current Mental Health / Discovery calls and host-eligibility rules for Australia

pitch.framing: A digitally measured, privacy-respecting approach to dementia support and prevention.
pitch.next_step: Partner an eligible research host (a QLD university) and target a Mental Health or Discovery call.

verification.notes: The funding directory confirms the research themes. It does not establish that an Australian university is an eligible administering host for every scheme.
